summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-node preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is a hex-identifier-obfuscated script (uses _0x488df8-style names and inline string-table maps to conceal control flow) that, when Bun is not already installed on the host, downloads a Bun runtime ZIP from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/, extracts the bun binary to a temp directory, chmods it to 0755, and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file math_init.js shipped in the package. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line file with a shuffled numeric string array (n7gIxM) and rotator function (WV8StW) consistent with commercial JavaScript obfuscator output. Installing the package therefore causes an opaque, obfuscated payload to be executed by an alternate language runtime that the package fetches at install time, bypassing Node-based supply-chain scanners. An ESLint configuration package has no legitimate reason to fetch a second language runtime or to ship a 727 KB obfuscated blob for execution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
